prompt.project_info: Create a sunny luxury yacht portrait with natural adult fashion styling and deep-blue open sea.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long wavy brown hair caught by the wind and a natural relaxed expression. She wears a light lilac bikini with gold inserts, a translucent mesh cardigan, and a gold chain at the waist, standing at the yacht railing with one hand raised above her head.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing at the railing against open sea and bright sky with clouds, one hand raised and the other extended naturally, full upper-body to mid-thigh fashion frame, clear nautical deck and railing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sunny natural daylight, deep blue water, soft bright clouds, relaxed luxurious summer-vacation atmosphere, realistic fabric and water texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic natural appearance, high-resolution fashion lifestyle photography, balanced vertical framing, natural perspective, crisp sea horizon and realistic mesh texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic photograph of an adult woman standing at the railing of a yacht, posing with one hand raised above her head against open sea and a bright sky with clouds. She has long wavy brown hair loose and caught in the wind and a natural relaxed expression. She wears a light lilac bikini with gold inserts, a translucent mesh cardigan, and a gold chain at the waist. Sunny nautical atmosphere, deep blue water all around, luxurious summer vacation mood, realistic skin and fabric texture, high-resolution fashion lifestyle photography, natural balanced perspective.
